title: BeingDB explorer
description: Querying the REWIND interviews demo dataset. To query your own facts, open this page with `?data=` and the URL of a `beingdb export` file (served with CORS), or publish your own copy with `npm run bundle`.

examples.title: Works made 1975-1980
examples.query:
find Artist, Work, Y
where
  created_by(Work, Artist)
  year_created(Work, Y)
  Y between 1975 and 1980
order by Y ascending

examples.title: Most prolific artists
examples.query:
find Artist, count(Work)
where
  created_by(Work, Artist)
order by count(Work) descending
limit 5

examples.title: Exhibitions about video
examples.query:
find Exhibition, Title
where
  exhibition_title(Exhibition, Title)
  Title contains "video"
